dct_description_sm:
Data set geolocating road signs on Montreal territory.

 It should be noted that [road signs concerning parking] (/city-of-montreal/parking-on-street-signalisation-currant) are available in a separate set.

Additional files provide more details on the descriptions and 

the codifications of the panels. The images of all the panels are also available.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
